content.comment_body: Hello everyone! I'm encountering an issue with a mathematical instruction block. I'm using [product_name] [version_no] and [article_no]. Standard setup. I can't set the operation in this block; instead of an operation selection, I just see a dot and can't change it to any symbol (+, -, etc.). According to the specs, I have 45 blocks remaining before reaching the memory limit in this program, and none of them have retentivity enabled. Has anyone found a solution for this? Thank you!

Hi, Regarding the Program Memory size, have you pressed F2 to check for any messages? It's not just the mathematical functions; it looks like the priority settings are missing as well. If possible, please attach your program in a zipped file so it can be evaluated.
Thanks for the quick reply. Here’s the information requested...
And here’s the program file. This is my first project, so please go easy with the feedback.
Increase the size of the properties window to reveal the operation symbols.

Hi, After testing with your program, I can see the operands regardless of the properties window size. When checking in Classic View, the symbols disappear but you can still choose them. Try changing the style under Options → Look and Feel.
That resolved the issue—so simple. Thank you so much!

analysis.insight_summary: The main issue was difficulty in accessing mathematical operation symbols within the math instruction block when using [product_name] [version_no] and [article_no]. The symbols were not visible or selectable, leading to confusion about available functions. Discussion revealed the problem was due to the graphical interface layout or display style in the software, rather than hardware memory or configuration. User satisfaction improved once the correct display setting was chosen.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects easy access and configuration of mathematical operations within the math function blocks, as outlined by the hardware and software instructions.
